detail: tgz18gqce8 and 9khdul5b6e both done and pushed (commit c8e2ccd). FoodGroups is now a full-stack app: register/login (part1) against the part2 JWT API, every route gated behind RequireAuth, and AppContext fetching/mutating through real HTTP instead of localStorage. No declared tasks remain in the hub. Verified live end-to-end (not just typecheck/build): ran part1 + part2 against a real Postgres (PGlite), registered two accounts, created a group, joined it by invite code from the second account, posted a review and a comment, toggled both likes, edited a profile, logged out and back in to confirm the data persisted server-side, and confirmed one account never sees another's groups. Zero console errors across the run. Both packages build and typecheck clean.
